Speed | c1_header = x% increased Warcry Speed | c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% increased Warcry Speed | c1_pattern_value = %s%% }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill threshold jewel list|stat_id=jewel_warcry}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( items.name LIKE "%warcry%" OR items.description LIKE "%warcry%" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * No longer grants a buff which makes it easier for you to stun enemies. * The user and nearby allies now gain a buff that increases their armour and stun threshold (not Enemy stun threshold). * Buff grants 5% more Armour per 5 Power and 15% increased Stun Threshold per 5 Power, counting a maximum of 25 power. * Exerted Attacks now have 50% more Area of Effect (previously 30% increased, and 30% increased Area of Effect per previous Attack Exerted by this Warcry). * Now Exerts the next 6 Melee Slam Attacks you perform (previously 4). * It has a 2.5 second duration at gem level 1 (previously 4), scaling up to 3.4 at gem level 20 (previously 4.9). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides 0-40% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate (previously 0-20%). }} {{Version history table row|3.21.0| * Quality on Seismic Cry now provides 0-20% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate (previously 0-10%). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * No longer has “Exerted Attacks deal 30% more Damage”. * No longer has “Exerted Attacks deal 20% more Damage per previous Attack Exerted by this Warcry”. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| *Exerted Attacks now deal 20% more Damage per previous Attack Exerted by this Warcry (previously 30%). }} {{Version history table row|3.11.0| * Seismic Cry has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}} {{sister|poe2wiki}}
